patterns.question: Which of our peer groups fits this company? (description + financials + 3 example members per group; 2 shuffled reads)
patterns.use: review queue for the peer audit — never auto-apply

rule.metric: agrees with reviewed truth (hard set + random names)

patterns.question: From this analyst headline only, what did the firm do? (upgrade/downgrade/initiate/PT raise/PT cut/reiterate/other)
Is this headline one firm's call on this stock, or a roundup/other?
Is this headline good / neutral / bad for <company>'s stock in the short term?

rule.metric: rank corr with same-day abnormal move (pre-open headlines)
rule.baseline: keyword lexicon IC 0.080; OpenJev adds coverage where keywords are silent (IC +0.05…+0.09)

patterns.notes: never a trading signal (next-day IC ≈ 0, see R01)

patterns.question: If <oil / AI-chip spending / housing / consumer spending> jumps, is this company hurt, little affected, or helped?
patterns.use: scenario exposure panel (A149), with realized betas

rule.metric: rank corr with realized factor beta beyond SPY (worst of the 4)

patterns.question: Calibrated head on OpenJev headline answers → P(big move today) for a ticker-day
patterns.notes: only ~35 positives in test; needs more labels

patterns.question: Does this headline report <entity>'s own view on markets/economy?
patterns.use: gate: drop headlines that are NOT the entity's view (pre-filter)

rule.metric: precision of the drop (true 'not a view')

patterns.notes: yes-side only ~60 % precise → never use alone

patterns.question: Is this news big enough to move the stock unusually today? (alone)
patterns.notes: not proven better than counting headlines

patterns.question: Will this stock beat the market tomorrow / next week? (from news, state, or scores)
patterns.notes: also failed on the A129 forecast lab

patterns.question: Is this fair value / target / weight about right? (any question that SHOWS it a number to judge)

rule.metric: share of the answer NOT moved by a fake number

patterns.notes: copies whatever number it is shown (shift 2.9 of 4 buckets)

patterns.question: Which vendor's value is right / why do sources disagree?

rule.metric: agrees with simple rules where they fire

patterns.question: From this chart, is today near a short-term low/high? Will it be higher in 2 weeks?
patterns.notes: signal absent in price shape (S004), not an OpenJev limit

patterns.question: Will this put expire OTM? (vs market-implied odds)
If gold / bitcoin jumps, is this company hurt or helped?
Would a developer need to read or edit this file to do <task>? (path + first 80 lines)
patterns.use: gate: skip reading files with P < 0.1

rule.metric: share of truly needed files KEPT

patterns.label_source: git history: files a commit changed vs untouched files in the same folder

patterns.question: Does this command/test/log output contain a failure that needs action?
patterns.use: gate: read only flagged chunks of long output

rule.baseline: regex (oj run uses regex OR OpenJev)

patterns.label_source: 40-line chunks of /tmp/fildi-logs/*.log; regex failure keywords (weak labels)
patterns.notes: `oj.py run` = regex OR OpenJev per 40-line chunk + always the tail; regex-labelled eval (weak) — OpenJev's extra value = semantic catches

patterns.question: Does this diff affect scores, Model List picks, option pricing, backtests or market-data pipelines?
patterns.use: review-loop gate: quant review or not
patterns.label_source: commits with Refs to [quant] rows + path rules (needs ≥ 50/class)

patterns.question: Is new idea X the same need as existing ASKS row A##? (top-5 by keyword first)
patterns.notes: `oj.py dupes` ranks by keywords (P14 lesson); `--oj` adds OpenJev as 2nd opinion; unmeasured (only ~8 labelled dups)

patterns.question: Does study S0xx already answer question Q? (over research/studies/INDEX.md rows)

rule.metric: queries whose top-3 studies include a cited one

patterns.label_source: ASKS files that cite S0xx (citing ≠ answering → weak labels)

measured.secondary: 1890 query×study pairs; random top-3 would hit ~9% per cited study

patterns.notes: 10-18: OpenJev top-3 14/54 vs keyword overlap 24/54 → `oj.py studies` now uses keywords only (no model)

patterns.question: Which skill / context file does this task need? (choice over the SKILLS table)
patterns.notes: command exists (oj.py dupes / skill); too few labels to measure yet → hint only

Does this commit message match the staged diff?
Does this diff make section S of doc D out of date?
